title.ja: 図1-1 角道を閉じずに四間飛車に
title.en: Figure 1-1: Fourth File Rook without closing the bishop diagonal

explain.ja: 角交換四間飛車の最大の特徴は、角道を閉じずに四間飛車に組むことです。この局面から基本的な駒組みを見ていきましょう。通常の四間飛車の指し方は別の記事で解説しています。
explain.en: The defining feature of Bishop Exchange Fourth-File Rook is that you build the Fourth-File Rook without closing the bishop diagonal. Let us look at the basic piece development from this position. The normal Fourth-File Rook is covered in another article.

section.ja: 角道を開けたまま四間飛車に
section.en: Open the bishop diagonal and go to Fourth-File Rook

title.ja: 図1-2 相手が玉を動かしたら…
title.en: Figure 1-2: If the opponent moves the king...

explain.ja: 角道を開けたまま自然に駒組みを進めます。相手が△4二玉と指したところがポイントで、ここで必ず指しておきたい手があります。
explain.en: Develop naturally with the bishop diagonal left open. The key moment is when the opponent plays △4二玉, because there is a move you must play here.

section.ja: 相手が玉を動かしたタイミングで角交換!
section.en: Trade bishops when the opponent moves the king

title.ja: 図1-3 壁銀の形にさせる
title.en: Figure 1-3: Make White's silver a wall silver shape

explain.ja: 相手が玉を動かしたタイミングで、こちらから角交換をします。▲2二角成に△同銀と取るしかなく、相手の守りの銀が玉の守りから離れてしまいます。この銀の形は「壁銀」と呼ばれる悪形です。相手を壁銀にするのがポイントで、角交換の前に△3二玉とされると、▲2二角成に△同玉と取れるので注意が必要です。
explain.en: When the opponent moves the king, trade bishops yourself. ▲2二角成 can only be answered by △同銀, which pulls the opponent's defending silver away from the king's side. This silver shape is called a wall silver (kabegin) and is considered bad. Making the opponent's silver a wall silver is the point; if the opponent had already played △3二玉 before the bishop exchange, ▲2二角成 could be taken with △同玉, so be careful.

section.ja: 相手が玉を動かしたタイミングで角交換!
section.en: Trade bishops when the opponent moves the king

title.ja: 図1-4 銀で飛車先を受ける
title.en: Figure 1-4: Receive the rook-file pawn with the silver

explain.ja: 角交換四間飛車では、▲7七銀として相手の飛車先を受けるのが基本です。ここに銀がいれば、相手は△8六歩、▲同歩、△同飛と飛車を走ることができません。通常の四間飛車では▲7七角で飛車先を受けますが、角交換で角がいなくなるため、銀で受けます。
explain.en: In Bishop Exchange Fourth-File Rook, the basic way to meet the opponent's rook-file pawn is ▲7七銀. With the silver there, the opponent cannot run the rook with △8六歩, ▲同歩, △同飛. In the normal Fourth-File Rook the bishop on 7七 does this job, but after the bishop exchange there is no bishop, so the silver covers instead.

section.en: Meet the rook pawn with the silver

title.ja: 図1-5 片美濃囲いにするのが基本
title.en: Figure 1-5: Building Single Mino is basic

explain.ja: 角交換四間飛車では、囲いは片美濃囲いにするのが基本です。ここからはいきなり攻める順もあれば、囲いをさらに固めて玉を堅くする手もあります。これで角交換四間飛車の基本形が完成です。
explain.en: In Bishop Exchange Fourth-File Rook the basic castle is the Half Mino. From here you can attack right away, or strengthen the castle further to make the king firmer. This completes the basic formation of Bishop Exchange Fourth-File Rook.

section.ja: 囲いは片美濃囲いにするのが基本
section.en: Using the Katamino castle is the basic idea

title.ja: 図a-1 角の打ち込みに注意
title.en: Figure a-1: Beware of the bishop drop

explain.ja: 角交換四間飛車では序盤から互いに角を持ち駒にするので、角の打ち込みに注意が必要です。特に美濃囲いに組むとき、玉を動かす前に▲3八銀と上がってしまうと、△2八角と打ち込まれる隙ができます。
explain.en: Since both sides hold a bishop in hand from the opening, watch out for bishop drops. In particular, when building the Mino castle, if you play ▲3八銀 before moving the king, you leave a hole for the drop △2八角.

section.ja: 囲いは片美濃囲いにするのが基本
section.en: Using the Katamino castle is the basic idea

title.ja: 図2-1 いきなり飛車先を交換されたら？
title.en: Figure 2-1: What if the rook-file pawns are exchanged right away?

explain.ja: 図1-1に戻り、相手からいきなり仕掛けられたときの対応を見ます。相手が8筋の歩を伸ばして飛車を走らせてきました。一見すると龍を作られそうですが、ここに切り返しがあります。こちらはまだ▲7七銀の形ができていないので受けがなさそうに見えますが、そこで有効な手があります。
explain.en: Going back to Diagram 1-1, let us see how to respond when the opponent attacks right away. The opponent advanced the 8th-file pawn and ran the rook. It looks as if a dragon will be made, but there is a counter. Since the ▲7七銀 setup is not yet in place, there seems to be no defense, but there is an effective reply.

section.ja: 飛車先交換されたら、角交換して▲7七角
section.en: If the rook pawn is exchanged, trade bishops and play ▲7七角

line.text: △8四歩、▲4八玉、△8五歩、▲3八玉、△8六歩、▲同歩、△同飛

title.ja: 図2-2 飛車銀両取りが切り返し
title.en: Figure 2-2: Fork on rook and silver is the counter

explain.ja: 相手が飛車先を交換してきたら、角交換してから▲7七角と打つのが切り返しで、これが飛車と銀の両取りになります。振り飛車党なら覚えておきたい、よく出てくる手順です。
explain.en: If the opponent trades pawns on the rook file, the counter is to exchange bishops and then drop the bishop with ▲7七角, which forks the rook and silver. This sequence comes up often, so every Ranging Rook player should remember it.

section.ja: 飛車先交換されたら、角交換して▲7七角
section.en: If the rook pawn is exchanged, trade bishops and play ▲7七角

title.ja: 図2-3 攻め合いなら振り飛車有利
title.en: Figure 2-3: In a race of attacks the Ranging Rook side is ahead

explain.ja: 図2-2から互いに攻め合う展開になれば、振り飛車が有利です。すでに駒割は銀桂交換で振り飛車側が駒得になっており、このあと桂馬や香車を取りに行くこともできます。また▲8八飛として飛車交換を狙い、龍を消しに行く手もあります。
explain.en: If the game turns into a mutual attacking race from Diagram 2-2, the Ranging Rook side is better. The material is already a silver-for-knight trade in the Ranging Rook side's favor, and it can also go after the knight and lance later. There is also ▲8八飛, aiming for a rook trade to eliminate the dragon.

section.ja: 攻め合う展開なら振り飛車有利
section.en: In a slugfest, Ranging Rook is better

title.ja: 図2-4 両取りを受ける手
title.en: Figure 2-4: Move to defend against the fork

explain.ja: 図2-2からは、△8二飛と引くのが唯一の受けです。これで飛車と銀の両取りは受かりますが、振り飛車側にはさらに強烈な攻めがあります。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-2, retreating with △8二飛 is the only defense. This parries the fork on rook and silver, but the Ranging Rook side still has a powerful attack.

section.ja: 飛車を引いて受けられたら、垂らしの歩が手筋
section.en: If the rook is retreated to defend, the dangling pawn is the tesuji

title.ja: 図2-5 歩を垂らすのが手筋
title.en: Figure 2-5: Dangling a pawn is the tesuji

explain.ja: ここでは▲2四歩と歩を垂らすのが手筋です。△同飛なら銀のヒモが外れるので▲2二角成、相手が放置しても次の▲2三歩成、△同飛、▲2二角成を狙えます。さらに▲2三歩成を受けようと△7二金などとすると、飛車の横利きが止まるので、やはり▲2二角成です。
explain.en: Here the tesuji is to dangle a pawn with ▲2四歩. If △同飛, the silver loses its protection, so ▲2二角成 follows. If the opponent ignores it, ▲2三歩成, △同飛, ▲2二角成 is threatened next. And if the opponent tries to stop ▲2三歩成 with something like △7二金, the rook's sideways coverage is cut off, so again ▲2二角成 works.

section.ja: 飛車を引いて受けられたら、垂らしの歩が手筋
section.en: If the rook is retreated to defend, the dangling pawn is the tesuji

explain.ja: 図2-4からは、逆に振り飛車側から8筋を攻めていく手も有力です。相手が8筋を攻めてきたはずが、気づけば振り飛車側が逆襲している形です。今回の解説はここまでです。角交換四間飛車からの攻め筋は、逆棒銀の記事も参考にしてください。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-4, attacking on the 8th file from the Ranging Rook side is also a strong option. The opponent started by attacking on the 8th file, yet before long the Ranging Rook side is counterattacking. That ends this explanation. For attacking plans from Bishop Exchange Fourth-File Rook, see also the article on the Reverse Climbing Silver.

section.ja: 飛車を引いて受けられたら、垂らしの歩が手筋
section.en: If the rook is retreated to defend, the dangling pawn is the tesuji
